from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess,sys
expected = '/workspace/scratch/b566cace4ed6/pfds/toolchains/elan-4.2.4/elan-init'
expected_lean = '/workspace/scratch/b566cace4ed6/pfds/toolchains/lean-4.35.0-native/bin/lean'
selected = shutil.which("elan")
resolved = str(Path(selected).resolve()) if selected else None
record = {"selected_elan":selected,"resolved_elan":resolved,"expected_elan":expected}
if resolved != expected:
    record["selection_matches"] = False
    record["wrong_executable_invoked"] = False
    print(json.dumps(record))
    raise SystemExit(7)
record["selection_matches"] = True
record["elan_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(Path(resolved).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert record["elan_sha256"] == "e0f4b30b29c565625189744847dfef5f132b6322c5e452dbebfeae780c9749e5"
for key,argv in [("elan_version",["elan","--version"]),("selected_lean",["elan","which","lean"])]:
    result=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=30)
    record[key]=result.stdout.strip()
assert "elan 4.2.4 (227caca13 2026-08-25)" == record["elan_version"]
assert str(Path(record["selected_lean"]).resolve()) == expected_lean
result=subprocess.run([record["selected_lean"],"--version"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=30)
record["lean_version"]=result.stdout.strip()
assert "Lean (version 4.35.0," in record["lean_version"] and "eb6cafb7290e8bd5f2937522d8d804f58f02bafc" in record["lean_version"]
print(json.dumps(record))
